name: Apex Grand Prix Circuit (original procedural layout)
axes: Y up; track in XZ plane; right-handed (glTF/three.js)
direction: clockwise when viewed from above (+Y), start line at x=0 heading +X
edgeSurfaces: per point [left,right] surface just outside the track edge (0..18 m): grass|gravel|runoff

racingLine.note: approximate geometric line; lateral metres from centre (+ = driver's right)

aiSpeed.note: target speeds along the racing line, metres/second; built with 32 m/s^2 lateral grip, 12 m/s^2 accel, 38 m/s^2 braking, 88 m/s top

render.note: baked vertex shadows use this sun direction; put the real-time DirectionalLight along it
render.bakedLighting: vertex colours (COLOR_0) on ground meshes, buildings and stands
